info.title: sCalenderPlus API
info.description: Public REST API of sCalenderPlus. See docs/architecture/api.md.

get.summary: Liveness: the process is up (no dependency checks).
Readiness: database reachable and migrated (worker: job loop heartbeat).

post.description: Always answers 202 for a well-formed request with an allowed email domain (disposable-email providers: 422 email_domain_not_allowed): a new account gets a confirmation email, an already registered address gets a hint email instead (no user enumeration). Sign in afterwards with POST /auth/login.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Sign in with email and password
post.description: Sets the session cookie, or answers twoFactorRequired (second step: POST /auth/login/2fa). Failures are 401 invalid_credentials; after 5 failures in a row the account is locked for 15 minutes (still answered as invalid_credentials).

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Second login step: authenticator code or recovery code
post.description: Needs the pending-login cookie from POST /auth/login (twoFactorRequired, valid 5 minutes); without it 401 unauthenticated. Wrong codes are 401 invalid_credentials and count towards the lockout; each recovery code works once.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.description: 404 for groups the caller is not a member of (no existence leaks).

patch.summary: Rename or change settings (admins and owners; JSON Merge Patch, requires If-Match)
patch.description: Absent or null members stay unchanged; an empty description removes it. Members and viewers: 403 insufficient_permission. If-Match: the ETag of GET /groups/{id} (or *).

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

delete.summary: Delete the group with its memberships and invites (owners only, requires If-Match)

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.description: Every member sees the list unless memberListVisibility is members_and_above (viewers: 403). Emails are only shown to admins and owners.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

patch.description: Owners assign any role; admins manage members and viewers only and assign at most member (only owners promote to admin or owner); everyone may lower their own role. The last owner cannot be demoted (409 last_owner), the billing owner only after transferring billing (409 billing_owner_transfer_required); frozen groups refuse role changes (409 group_frozen). revokeEventShares (default true): on demotion also revoke the member's individual event shares on the group's calendars.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

delete.summary: Remove a member, or leave the group with your own user id (requires If-Match)
delete.description: Owners remove anyone, admins members and viewers; everyone may leave. Last-owner and billing-owner protection as for role changes. revokeEventShares (default true): also revoke the member's individual event shares on the group's calendars.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Make another owner the billing owner (billing owner only)
post.description: The recipient must be a member with role owner (409 billing_owner_must_be_owner); their plan governs the group from now on.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Invite by email or create an invite link (admins and owners)
post.description: With email: a single-use invite sent to that address (en/de), usable only by an account whose verified email matches; a new invite replaces pending ones for the address. Without email: an invite link (role at most member, maxUses 1–1000, default 50) returned once in url. role: owners invite any role, admins up to member. expiresInDays: 1–30 (default 14 for email, 7 for links). Frozen groups: 409 group_frozen.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.summary: Pending invites of a group (admins and owners, cursor-paginated)

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

delete.summary: Revoke an invite (admins and owners; idempotent)
delete.description: Admins can revoke invites with roles up to member. Revoking an expired, used or revoked invite is a no-op.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Join a group with an invite token
post.description: Needs a verified email address (403 email_not_verified); email invites only for the invited address (403 invite_email_mismatch). Unknown, expired, revoked and used-up tokens are 400 token_invalid alike. Members accepting again keep their role. Returns the group.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.summary: Calendars I see, with my level (cursor-paginated)
get.description: Owned by me or one of my groups, or shared with me or my groups; ordered by creation. limit: 1–200 (default 50); cursor: nextCursor of the previous page.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Create a personal calendar, or a group calendar (group admins and owners)
post.description: Counts against owned_calendars of the owner's plan (group calendars: the group's billing owner) → 402 plan_limit_reached. Group members below admin: 403; non-members: 404.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.description: 404 for calendars the caller has no level on (no existence leaks).

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

patch.summary: Change name, color, time zone, permission settings or role defaults (manage; JSON Merge Patch, requires If-Match)
patch.description: Absent or null members stay unchanged; an empty description removes it. Below manage: 403. Role defaults never above the caller's level; a change that would take away the caller's own manage level is 409 permission_self_lockout. Frozen calendars: 409 calendar_frozen. If-Match: the ETag of GET /calendars/{id} (or *).

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

delete.summary: Delete the calendar with its grants (owners only, requires If-Match)

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.description: Ordered by creation. Below manage: 403; no level: 404.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Share the calendar with a user or a group (manage)
post.description: Levels free_busy … manage, never owner or above the caller's level (400 validation_failed). Principals: users who share a group with the caller or already see the calendar; the caller's groups or groups that already have a grant (else 400). One grant per principal (409 conflict). Frozen calendars: 409 calendar_frozen.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

patch.summary: Change a grant's level (manage; requires If-Match)
patch.description: Old and new level at most the caller's own. A change that would take away the caller's own manage level is 409 permission_self_lockout. If-Match: the grant's etag (or *).

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

delete.description: A removal that would take away the caller's own manage level is 409 permission_self_lockout.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.summary: Events in a time window, as I see them (not paged)
get.description: Events of every calendar I see (or only calendarIds; unknown or invisible ids are ignored) plus events shared with me, overlapping [from, to) (RFC 3339 instants; at most 13 months), ordered by start; each with myLevel. free_busy events come as the busy projection (title null, times only); transparent events are left out for free_busy, and none-level events never appear. All-day events are dates: with timeZone (IANA) they are placed by their dates in that zone, without it every all-day event whose dates overlap the window in some zone (UTC−12 … UTC+14) is returned. At most 5,000 events (truncated: true when more matched).

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

post.summary: Create a single event in a calendar (contribute)
post.description: Timed ({ dateTime, timeZone }, zone default: the calendar's) or all-day ({ date }, end exclusive). A local time in a DST gap is shifted forward and reported in warnings (time_shifted_dst_gap); an ambiguous one takes the earlier offset (time_ambiguous_earlier_offset). Below contribute: 403; no level: 404. Frozen calendars: 409 calendar_frozen. Recurrence: 422 recurrence_not_supported. Duplicate uid: 409 uid_conflict.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.description: free_busy callers get the busy projection (times only, title null). 404 for events the caller has no level on, and for transparent events at free_busy (no existence leaks).

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

patch.summary: Change an event (edit; JSON Merge Patch, requires If-Match)
patch.description: Absent or null members stay unchanged; an empty description, location, url or color, or empty categories, remove the value. Below edit: 403. Frozen calendars: 409 calendar_frozen. If-Match: the ETag of GET /events/{id} (or *); stale: 412.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

delete.summary: Delete an event (edit; soft delete, requires If-Match)

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.summary: The event's permission overrides (event level manage, with ETag)
get.description: Only those who may change them see them: calendar managers and owners, and the creator while the creator floor applies. Others who see the event: 403 insufficient_permission; no level: 404.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

put.summary: Replace the event's permission overrides (event level manage; requires If-Match)
put.description: Atomic replace of the whole set (an empty list removes all). Levels none … edit; manage, the same principal twice, or a group/user you may not select: 422 override_invalid (violations). Sharing with people outside the calendar's audience needs calendar manage (or the calendar setting creatorsMayShareExternally): else 403 external_sharing_not_allowed (violations). Unchanged and lowered entries are not re-checked. Plan limits: 402 plan_limit_reached (removals always pass). Frozen calendars allow removals only (409 calendar_frozen). If-Match: the ETag of GET /events/{id}/overrides (or *).

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

get.summary: Why a user has their level on the event (the permission engine's steps)
get.description: Without userId: the caller's own level (anyone who sees the event). With another userId: calendar manage or owner on the event's calendar (else 403 insufficient_permission with calendar levels); the user must be in the calendar's audience, named by a user override of the event, or share a group with the caller — otherwise, and for unknown ids, 404. Steps only mention what matched that user.

default.description: Error (RFC 9457 problem details with a stable `code`).

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error code (part of the contract; never renamed).

ProblemDetails.description: RFC 9457 problem details. Further members depend on the code (e.g. `limit`, `required`, `actual`).
